Privacy

Privacy Policy

How Pellikal Window Enhancements handles the information you share with us through this website.

Last updated: 14 September 2026

Who we are

Pellikal Window Enhancements provides residential and commercial window film and window-performance solutions, including custom window inserts, across Long Island and New York City. You can reach us at 516-336-9586 or info@pellikal.com. This policy covers the website at www.pellikal.com.

Information you give us

The personal information you actively provide to us is what you type into our consultation form — typically your name, phone number, email address, the town your property is in, and whatever you tell us about your project. We use it for one purpose: to respond to your enquiry and discuss the work. We do not sell it, rent it, or trade it.

Form submissions are delivered to us by Formspree, a third-party form service, and reach us by email. Pellikal’s own database (Supabase) is used for website content and administration — project photographs, testimonials and editable page text — and does not currently store contact-form submissions.

Marketing email

Requesting a quote does not add you to any marketing list. We will only send you marketing messages if you separately and clearly opt in, and you can ask us to stop at any time.

Information collected automatically

Our web host records standard technical information such as your IP address, browser type and the pages requested. This is ordinary server logging used to keep the site running and secure.

Your tracking choices

When you first arrive, optional analytics and advertising storage and personalised advertising signals are switched off. Google’s Consent Mode may still send limited cookieless measurement signals while those categories are denied. You can choose Accept All, Reject Non-Essential, or Manage Preferences to switch Analytics and Advertising on or off separately. Nothing optional is pre-selected.

We record your choice in a first-party cookie named pellikal_consent, kept for 180 days, and keep a mirror of the same preference in your browser’s localStorage so your selection can be restored reliably. Both hold exactly four things: the consent schema version, your Analytics choice, your Advertising choice, and the date. Neither contains your name, email address, phone number, anything you typed into a form, or anything else about you.

Cookies and tracking technologies

The technologies this site uses, grouped by the categories in the preferences dialog.

  • Necessary — always on. The pellikal_consent cookie described above, which only remembers your choice. On the private staff page at /admin/, a sign-in session held in your browser for that tab only. No analytics or advertising identifiers are set in this category.
  • Analytics — optional. Google Analytics 4 (property G-J8SQ4CC7BT), loaded through Google Tag Manager. When on, Google may set its own cookies and identifiers in your browser to count visits, pages and traffic sources in aggregate. Those cookies belong to Google; their names and lifetimes are set by Google and described in Google’s own documentation.
  • Advertising — optional. Google Ads conversion measurement and remarketing (account AW-859941989), loaded through Google Tag Manager. When on, Google may store advertising identifiers to attribute an enquiry to an advertisement and to show our ads to people who have visited this site. Turning it off keeps ad storage, ad user data and ad personalisation all denied.

Fonts. The typeface on this site is loaded from Google Fonts. That request goes to Google when a page loads, regardless of your tracking choice, and Google receives standard technical information such as your IP address in order to serve the file. It sets no cookies. We list it here because it is a third-party request you cannot switch off from the preferences dialog.

To change your mind at any time, use the link — it is also in the footer of every page — and choose again.

An honest note about what declining does and does not do: choosing Reject Non-Essential stops cookies and identifiers being used for analytics and advertising. It does not stop every technical request to Google. Google’s Consent Mode may still send limited signals that carry no cookie and no advertising identifier, and are used only for aggregate, modelled estimates. We would rather say that plainly than claim a total block we do not deliver.

Analytics and advertising measurement

This website uses Google Tag Manager to load and manage the measurement tools listed below, and Google Analytics 4 to understand how visitors find and use the site.

Tag Manager is a container: a tool can be added to it without changing this website’s own code. We keep the list below current, and we configure anything that sets cookies or identifiers to follow the choice you made above. If you think this list has fallen out of date, tell us and we will correct it.

  • Google Tag Manager — the container that loads and manages the tools below.
  • Google Analytics 4 (property G-J8SQ4CC7BT) — aggregate statistics such as pages viewed, how you arrived, and general location at city level.
  • Google Ads conversion measurement and remarketing (account AW-859941989) — to understand which advertisements lead to enquiries, and potentially to show our ads to people who have visited this site.
  • Microsoft Clarity — session analytics, which records how pages are scrolled and clicked. Not currently enabled. If we switch it on it will be treated as optional analytics — it will run only if you choose Accept All — and this page will be updated first.
  • Call tracking — not currently in use. If introduced, a phone number shown on the site may be a forwarding number that records which advertisement or source a call came from. Calls would still connect to Pellikal normally, and this page would be updated first.

When you accept, these tools may set cookies or similar identifiers in your browser. We record only that an action happened — for example that a form was submitted, or that a phone, text or email link was tapped, and roughly where on the page it was tapped.

When you submit the consultation form successfully, you are sent to a short confirmation page at /thankyou/. That page load is what tells us an enquiry came from a particular advertisement. Nothing you typed is carried to it — not in the address bar, not on the page.

We do not intentionally include your contact-form details in our analytics or advertising measurement. The website’s measurement events are built so that the name, email address, phone number, property location and message text you submit are not included in the data sent to Google Analytics or Google Ads. What is recorded is the service category you picked from the dropdown and which page the form was on. Those details are used to respond to your enquiry.

Separately, when the measurement tools described above load in your browser, Google receives standard technical information such as your IP address, device and browser type, and the pages you view. That is how these services work, and it is governed by Google’s own privacy terms rather than by us.

You can also control cookies through your browser settings, opt out of Google Analytics using Google’s browser add-on, and manage advertising personalisation in your Google account settings.

Third parties we rely on

This site is hosted on GitHub Pages, forms are delivered by Formspree, website and CMS content is stored with Supabase, measurement is provided by Google, and fonts are served by Google Fonts. Each processes limited data on our behalf in order to provide their service.

How long we keep information

We keep enquiry details for as long as needed to respond and to maintain normal business records. You may ask us to delete your information at any time.

Your choices

You can ask what information we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it. Email info@pellikal.com or call 516-336-9586 and we will take care of it.

Children

This website is intended for adults arranging work on a property and is not directed at children.

Changes to this policy

If we change how we handle information — including switching on any of the measurement tools described above — we will update this page and change the date shown at the top.

Contact

Questions about this policy? Call or text 516-336-9586 or email info@pellikal.com.
